name: print-social-white-maze-pattern-have-any-more-questions-closing-slide
title: Have Any More Questions Closing Slide
whatItIs: A white slide with a faint maze pattern, a ticket logo, a tilted blue speech card with 'Have any more questions?' and below it black type 'Visit Tixpool.com' with the URL on a blue highlight block and 'or slide into our DMs. We don't bite.'
whatItMeans: A playful, human ending with a blue highlight on the URL makes the call to action easy to spot.
techniques: URL on a solid blue highlight block

vocabulary.definition: A solid rectangle behind key words.
An invitation to send a direct message.
A last line with an informal tone.
